title: Topological dimension computed on a surjective etale atlas of a quasi-separated space
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $Y$ be an algebraic space over $\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-trf-algebraic-space, def-weil-affine-spectrum], and assume its diagonal $Y\to Y\times_kY$ is quasi-compact: after every scheme test, inverse images of quasi-compact opens are quasi-compact. Give $|Y|$ its atlas topology [def-a1-space-point-topology]. For every representable surjective etale map $a:U\to Y$ from a scheme $U$ [def-pc-scheme], the topological Krull dimensions [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] satisfy $\dim|Y|=\dim|U|$. The equality includes infinite dimension and the empty space, whose dimension is $-\infty$. No finite type, quasi-compactness, equidimensionality or reducedness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Put $B=T=\operatorname{Spec}k$, with $T\to B$ the identity and $f:Y\to B$ the given structure map. Write $P=Y\times_B B$. On every scheme test $V$, the projection $p:P\to Y$ sends $(y,b)$ with $f(y)=b$ to $y$; its inverse sends $y$ to $(y,f(y))$. These are inverse natural transformations [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Thus $P$ is canonically $Y$, and the atlas $a$ becomes $\widetilde a:U\to P$, $u\mapsto(a(u),f(a(u)))$. On each scheme test this is the same atlas projection, so it is representable surjective etale. The diagonal of $f$ is exactly the quasi-compact diagonal in the hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 0A4J (lemma-dimension-decent-space), specialized via lem-sfb-space-etale-atlas-topological-dimension to the identity base change of Spec k.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-space-etale-atlas-topological-dimension] with $X=Y$, $B=T=\operatorname{Spec}k$, $T\to B=\operatorname{id}$, and atlas $\widetilde a:U\to P$. Its sole geometric hypothesis on $f$ is quasi-separatedness, verified in step 1. Its conclusion is $\dim|P|=\dim|U|$, including empty spaces and infinite dimension; it imposes no finite-type or quasi-compactness assumption on either $Y$ or $U$.

source.place: Tag 0A4J (lemma-dimension-decent-space), specialized via lem-sfb-space-etale-atlas-topological-dimension to the identity base change of Spec k.

proof.text: The inverse natural transformations $p$ and $p^{-1}$ identify field-valued point classes bijectively. They also identify their atlas topologies: a scheme test $V\to P$ is representable etale exactly when its composite $V\to Y$ is, since the scheme-test pullbacks are the same. Hence the inverse-image tests defining open subsets [def-a1-space-point-topology] are identical, so $|p|$ is a homeomorphism. By [lem-weil-pbc-homeomorphism-krull-dimension], $\dim|P|=\dim|Y|$. Combining with step 2 gives $\dim|Y|=\dim|U|$.
